description: This is an HTML file that contains a script for cross-window communication, extracting URL parameters, and periodically sending data to a parent editor window.

methods.name: gup
methods.description: Extracts the value of a query parameter from the current URL.

methods.name: sendData2Master
methods.description: Attempts to send data to a master object in the parent window, retrieved via URL parameters.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Initializes periodic sending of data when the page loads.
